description:
This Week in F-Droid

TWIF curated on Friday, 24 Jul 2026, Week 30

Community News

Fennec F-Droid was updated to 153.0.0 adding tab groups, another annoying instance of the privacy dashboard (So, Mozilla, your telemetry showed everybody disabling that from the Start page so you’ve added it to the Tab page because…? Pfft), downloads improvements and bug fixes as usual. One noteworthy announced feature was “Bookmark import: Import your bookmarks from a CSV file.” which I’ve run to use right away… to no avail, because I have no idea how to actually use, or where. (Ping us if you discover it, please!)
